services.name: Surf Lessons
services.desc: Beginner-friendly surf lessons at Kalapaki Beach with experienced instructors and small classes.

services.name: SUP Lessons
services.desc: Stand-up paddling is the fastest growing sport in the water. We have top stand-up paddle boards that anybody can ride. Kalapaki’s sheltered bay is ideal for learning paddling basics and is Kauai’s premier SUP surf break. We were guests at the Kauai Marriott Resort and decided to rent paddle boards as one of the last things we did before checking out. The conditions were perfect- smooth glassy water, light breeze to cool you down, cloudless skies- what more could you ask for? The service of the attendant at the rental stand was very helpful and the equipment was good quality. We'll do this again when we return! services.desc: Guided 45-minute outrigger canoe surfing and paddle experience in Kalapaki Bay led by an expert waterman.

services.name: Waterfall Rappel
services.desc: It’s not zip lining, it’s not rock climbing, it’s RAPPELLING Times 8:15 AM on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Please check our calendar for additional availabilities. 4 Hours About This guided rappel tour takes place on our private property that overlooks the Hule’ia watershed and Ha’upu Mountain range and has two SECRET waterfalls. After a detailed rappel safety lesson, and a practice run on the drywall, guests hike to two secluded waterfalls. Customers will first rappel the cascading 30' Bamboo Falls, followed by the towering 60’ Papakolea Falls. Guaranteed to be the most unique experience of your vacation!
